title: TenSEAL CKKS head evaluation: registered noise gates vs the integer path + honest single-query budget

registered_checks.qg3a: max |decoded*2^64 - integer_MAC| <= 2^32 (the CKKS noise gate at poly degree 8192, coeff bits [60,40,40,60], scale 2^40)
registered_checks.qg3b: argmax agreement between the decoded vector and the integer-path argmax >= 0.999 on n_rows = 20 real held-out rows
registered_checks.g5: per-query wall time (encrypt, evaluate, decrypt) and ciphertext bytes are RECORDED — measured numbers, never asserted

interpretation_registered_before_running.qg3_pass: the CKKS backend reproduces the registered arithmetic within the registered noise bound on the real head; the chain QG1/QG1b/QG2 -> QG3a/QG3b -> G5 is complete
interpretation_registered_before_running.qg3_fail: the CKKS noise exceeds the registered bound or the argmax disagrees — a negative finding; parameters or scheme are re-registered, never silently widened
interpretation_registered_before_running.g5: no pre-committed latency bound; the M195 band is the pricing context
